## Summary

Head of hardware at a YC S26 startup (Moonshot), founder of Auros, exited Runway AI at 16.

## Projects, most impressive first

- head of hardware @ yc startup: I lead engineering at Moonshot. We make an AI pendant, and it's shipping to customers now.
- founder @ auros: Auros is a personalized Linux you install with a double click. It's for people who aren't technical, or who just need a kiosk.
- exit @ runway ai at 16: Runway AI coaches pageant contestants with AI. It started as CoachT, for taekwondo studios, and I co-founded it and ran marketing.
- only engineer @ text-to-cad startup: Cadybara turns a description of a part into CAD. It's backed by Founders Inc, and I built it.
- founder @ drone startup: MossCross is backed by Founders Inc. We clean moss off Pacific Northwest roofs with drones and an autopilot I wrote. Everyone else does it by hand and makes too much to bother automating.
- stanford-sponsored rocket: It's 3D-printed and designed to land itself by tilting its own engine. I wrote a defense-grade 6-DOF simulator for it with live CFD and FEA that emulates its electronics and flight code, and ran it 14,030 times.
- research intern @ uw and northwestern: At UW I design autonomous drones with NOAA that run below, on and above the water, and do the data analysis that keeps them alive. At Northwestern I build multiscale physics simulations of metal 3D printing.
- coo @ indian edtech: I built Vaidra's speech pipeline in 7 languages for classrooms with one speaker and no screens. It reached 9,000+ students across 200+ schools.
- 2nd in division @ vex worlds: I've made Worlds 5 times in 8 seasons as captain and engineering lead. I started in 4th grade.
- mechanical team @ 250 lb battlebot: Bravado is aiming for BattleBots in 2028. Solo, as Mantis Combat Robotics, I designed and built 1, 3, 5 and 25 lb bots.
- led frc subteam: On Team 1899 I led 17 students across 3 subteams building a t-shirt cannon. I also built mechanisms for our robot, which qualified for the 2024 World Championship.

Updated 2026-09-24.
